name: openams
description: Open-source agency management system for independent insurance agencies.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @openams/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openams/api && npm run build --workspace @openams/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @openams/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openams/api && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.dev:firebase: npm run build --workspace @openams/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openams/api && node scripts/dev-firebase.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @openams/contracts && npm run build --workspace @openams/api && npm test --workspace @openams/api && npm test --workspace @openams/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @openams/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @openams/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @openams/web
scripts.check: npm run verify:oss-release && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build --workspace @openams/web
